svg.title: Estimate a target. Keep the residual.
svg.desc: Actual exported fixed synthetic I/Q, target estimate and unassigned residual. All three native STFT grids share one mixture-referenced dB scale. Supplied target priors are zero Hz and125kbaud. The residual contains interference, noise and reconstruction error. This is an indicator-only synthetic example, not a calibrated error bound or physical RF efficacy claim.

path.style: fill: #eeede6
